plans.name: Month-to-month
plans.note: No enrollment fee. Both monthly tiers are displayed against a struck-through $39.99. Under the compare-at precedent (§6) a struck-through figure is not a price, so $34.99 is recorded as the standing rate — but no end date is published, so whether $39.99 is a former standing rate due to return is unresolved. Flagged, not guessed. Gold's Gym does not publish an annual or maintenance fee on its public club pages or terms; the amount is unconfirmed either way, so it is not folded into the all-in figure.
